pages.text: Blueberries are harvested from fully grown Blueberry Crops.$(br2)Obtain Blueberry Seeds and plant them on farmland to grow the crop.
Plant Blueberry Seeds on farmland. A fully grown crop produces 1 Blueberry and 2 Blueberry Seeds when harvested.
Blueberries are edible and can be used to make Blueberry Jam.
